news.headline: DJ Uiagalelei to start for Chargers with Justin Herbert in concussion protocol
news.detail: Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert was ruled out for Sunday as he remains in concussion protocol, coach Jim Harbaugh said Friday, meaning DJ Uiagalelei will start against Tommy DeVito and the Patriots.
